text:
Maya Patel: quick sync — pushed a small change to the batch formation heuristic that biases for older requests (BatchFlux experiment).
Dan Kim: saw that — any telemetry we should watch specifically?
Maya Patel: want visibility on three things: batch_utilization, queue_depth by priority, and effective_tokens/sec (post-batching).
Priya Reddy: add kv_cache_hit_rate and avg_kv_size too. the change could change cache churn.
Sam Torres: +1 on kv metrics. Also we should track 'kernel_fallback_rate' — if kernel selection flips to slower kernels under different seq len distributions.
Maya Patel: good call. I'm going to add panels. thinking: batch_utilization(p50/p95), avg_tokens_per_batch, tokens_per_second_egress.
Dan Kim: for queue policies, can we split queue_depth by route and by token_budget bucket? e.g., small/medium/large token budgets.
Priya Reddy: yes. suggest buckets: <=64, 65-512, >512. that'll surface any heavy prompts starving short requests.
Sam Torres: for alerts — trigger if p95 queue depth for <=64 grows >20 for 2m and batch_utilization falls below 30%.
Maya Patel: agree. Also add a regression guard: track change in avg_latency_per_token over 5m windows before/after rollout.
Priya Reddy: I'm attaching a PromQL snippet we can use for effective tokens/sec
Priya Reddy: ```
sum(rate(tokens_emitted_total[1m])) by (model,route) / sum(rate(requests_total[1m])) by (model,route)
```
Sam Torres: that's tokens/request. tokens/sec per GPU would be `sum(rate(tokens_emitted_total[1m])) by (gpu_id)` — helpful for capacity planning.
Dan Kim: UI note: we should surface the sampling rate for batch traces. current sampling is 1% — for this experiment bump to 5% for 30m.
Maya Patel: changing sampling now. infra-bot can you patch trace-sampler to 5% for eng-runtime and set a TTL 30m?
infra-bot: deploy request received: trace-sampler -> 0.05 for cluster eng-runtime. will apply and post status. :gear:
infra-bot: done — sampling set to 5% (TTL 30m).
Priya Reddy: for KV cache churn, propose these panels: kv_cache_hit_rate(p50/p95), kv_cache_evictions_per_min, avg_kv_entry_ttl.
Sam Torres: add correlation heatmap between kv_cache_evictions_per_min and avg_batch_size. could reveal eviction storms caused by big batched requests.
Maya Patel: agreed. Also want to see kernel_fallback_count / minute and average_sequence_length at fallback time.
Dan Kim: small UX ask — in the dashboard legend show sample size (how many batches) for each time bucket so ppl don't misinterpret noisy p95.
Priya Reddy: I'll make a dashboard draft in Grafana and post link.
Maya Patel: timeline: put dashboards up, enable sampling, collect 30m of data, reconvene and decide whether to widen the bias or rollback.
Sam Torres: if we see latency regressing by >10% with no utilization wins, rollback earlier.
Dan Kim: ack. I'll watch autoscaler signals too — if we see sustained GPU token/sec drop we might need to revert.
Maya Patel: thanks team. Priya drop the dashboard link here when ready and I'll add the alert rules.
Priya Reddy: will do — posting in 20m. :thumbsup:
